pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.1.2: āḷavikā → yu. āḷavakā. | kuṭikāyo → yu. ma. kuṭiyo.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.1.9: caramāno → idaṃ pāṭhadvayaṃ sabbattha na dissati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.1.15: kho → yu. ma. potthakesu ayaṃ pāṭho na hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.2.19: āmantesi → netaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya …pe…  vigarahitvā dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesīti sabbapotthakesu āgataṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.6.1: hi → yu. potthakeyaṃ pāṭho na paññāyati. | sambhatānipi → dussambhatānipīti vā pāṭho.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:2.2.5: yācitabbā → dutiyampi yācitabbāti bhikkhū sandhāya bahuvacanaṃ vuttanti tabbaṇṇanā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:2.4.8: payoge → yu. ma. potthakesu idha. āmeṇḍitaṃ kataṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:3.3.1: dukkaṭānaṃ → āpatti dvinnaṃ saṅghādisesena dvinnaṃ dukkaṭānanti ādīsu ca dvīhi saṅghādisesehi saddhiṃ dvinnaṃ dukkaṭānantiādinā nayena attho veditabboti tabbaṇṇanā.
